pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to try
delete (first note whose name is "Meeting Notes")
return true
on error
return false
end try' && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to quit' && sleep 2
instruction: Create a new note titled 'Meeting Notes' and include a checklist with three items: 'Review agenda', 'Take notes', and 'Set follow-up tasks'.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to try
set foundNote to first note whose name is "Meeting Notes"
set noteContent to body of foundNote
set agendaFound to false
set notesFound to false
set followupFound to false
if noteContent contains "Review agenda" then
set agendaFound to true
end if
if noteContent contains "Take notes" then
set notesFound to true
end if
if noteContent contains "Set follow-up tasks" then
set followupFound to true
end if
if agendaFound and notesFound and followupFound then
return true
else
return false
end if
on error
return false
end try'
